title: UAAP: Elaine Etang's heroics lift Adamson over La Salle
summary: Elaine Etang took over late to power Adamson University past De La Salle University, 70-68, in the UAAP Season 89 women's basketball tournament on Sunday at the Blue Eagle Gym in Quezon City.
